title: Each type at a dholki
caption:
Dholki night: same songs, same cousins, sixteen completely different energies.

One is sitting near the door with an exit plan. One has laminated the lyrics. One is doing a solo nobody planned. And one is quietly retuning the dholak while everyone sings.

Tag your dholki crew and assign everyone their slide. Bonus points for tagging the one with the spoon.

Which one are you on dholki night?
